ui.saves.conflict_description: The saves changed on this device and in the cloud since they were last synced. The saves you don’t keep are replaced.
ui.saves.conflict_title: Which saves of “{title}” do you want to keep?
ui.saves.download_failed_description: The cloud may hold newer saves than this device. Try again, or play now with this device’s saves.
ui.backups.after_session_help: Ludusavi copies this game’s saves when you stop playing.
ui.backups.backup_failed: Couldn’t back up the saves of {title}
ui.backups.default_after_session: Back up every game after each session
ui.backups.default_after_session_help: The default for every game; each game’s settings can change it. Games with cloud saves upload first, then Ludusavi backs up.
ui.backups.found_no_version: Ludusavi is installed but didn’t answer
ui.backups.keeper_cloud: {store} cloud saves sync this game’s saves around each session. Ludusavi backs them up only when you ask.
ui.backups.keeper_cloud_and_ludusavi: {store} cloud saves sync this game’s saves, and Ludusavi backs them up after each session, once the upload is done.
ui.backups.keeper_ludusavi: Ludusavi backs up this game’s saves after each session.
ui.backups.keeper_ludusavi_cloud_manual: Ludusavi backs up this game’s saves after each session. {store} cloud saves sync only when you ask.
ui.backups.keeper_manual_both: {store} cloud saves and Ludusavi handle this game’s saves only when you ask.
ui.backups.keeper_nobody: Nothing backs up this game’s saves yet. Back up now, or turn on backups after each session.
ui.backups.missing_description: Irori backs up the saves of every game with Ludusavi, a free program you install yourself. Irori finds it once it’s installed.
ui.backups.missing_help: Irori looks on your PATH, in the usual install folders and on Flathub (com.github.mtkennerly.ludusavi).
ui.backups.no_match_help: Ludusavi doesn’t know this game by its name
ui.backups.no_match_alert: Choose the game’s title in Ludusavi with Change, so Ludusavi knows where its saves are.
ui.backups.prefix: Also looks in the Wine prefix
ui.backups.restore_cloud: {store} cloud saves also sync this game and may download newer saves over the restored ones at the next launch. Turn off automatic cloud sync for this game to keep them.
ui.backups.restore_elsewhere: This backup came from another Wine prefix, {path}, and its files go back there.
ui.backups.restore_files_one: The backup from {when} replaces the saves there now: {count} file, {size}.
ui.backups.restore_files_other: The backup from {when} replaces the saves there now: {count} files, {size}.
ui.backups.some_failed_one: {count} file couldn’t be copied. The app log lists it.
ui.backups.some_failed_other: {count} files couldn’t be copied. The app log lists them.
ui.backups.unchanged: The saves of {title} haven’t changed since the last backup
ui.notify.failed_start_body: Open Irori to see what went wrong.
ui.engine.missing: “{title}” plays with {engine}, which isn’t on this computer yet. Irori can download it from its project and start the game.
ui.engine.core_missing: {engine} needs its {core} core for this game, and Irori couldn’t download it. Check your connection and try again.
ui.engine.version_missing: “{title}” is set to use {engine} {version}, which was removed. Play with the version {engine} uses by default, or install that version again on the Emulators page.
ui.engine.manage_hint: You can choose another emulator for this game with “Play with…”.
ui.engine.installing_detail: The game starts when it’s ready.
ui.engine.bios: {system} games need a startup file from your own console, called a BIOS. Choose the folder where you keep it; any of these files will do:
ui.engine.bios_never: Irori never downloads BIOS files. They are copyrighted and must come from a console you own.
ui.engine.no_build: “{title}” plays with {engine}, which has no version for this computer yet. It runs on {hosts}.
ui.engine.no_download: “{title}” plays with {engine}, which Irori can’t download for this computer. Install it yourself and Irori finds it.
ui.engine.processor: {engine} runs games directly on the processor, and they need features this one lacks: {features}.
ui.launcher.missing: “{title}” starts through {launcher}, which isn’t in this game’s Wine prefix yet. Irori can download the official installer and run it there. Follow its window, and the game starts when it’s done.
ui.launcher.account: When {launcher} opens, sign in there. Irori never sees your login.
ui.launcher.installing_detail: Follow the installer’s window. The game starts when {launcher} is ready.
ui.sandbox.title: The sandbox can’t start
ui.sandbox.missing: “{title}” is set to run in a sandbox, but bubblewrap isn’t installed. Install it with your distribution’s package manager, then play again:
ui.sandbox.flatpak: “{title}” is set to run in a sandbox, but Irori’s Flatpak can’t start one: Flatpak doesn’t let the programs inside it create sandboxes of their own. Install Irori’s native package to play it sandboxed.
ui.sandbox.refused: “{title}” is set to run in a sandbox, but this system doesn’t let bubblewrap create one. Allow unprivileged user namespaces (on Ubuntu, AppArmor restricts them), then play again.
ui.sandbox.unsupported: Sandboxed games are only available on Linux.
ui.sandbox.not_run: Irori didn’t start the game without the sandbox.

ui.lutris.reason.missing_entry_point: Its Lutris settings name no program or game file.

ui.lutris.reason.system_not_supported: Irori has no emulator for its system yet.
ui.lutris.reason.steam_not_found: It isn’t in your Steam library on this computer.

ui.hidden_lock.saved: Hidden games are now behind a PIN
ui.hidden_lock.set_title: Lock hidden games with a PIN
